newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico 9-month private consumption rises 3.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 9-month private consumption rises 3.2 pct.

text.p: Private consumption rose 3.2 percent in the first nine-months of the year compared with the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
The Ministry also said that from January to September the global offer of goods and services rose 7.7 percent in real terms.
In the breakdown of global offer, 80.4 percent came from gross domestic product and 19.6 percent from imports of goods and services.
The Ministry said that within the increases in private consumption, durable goods rose 17.3 percent and non-durable goods rose 2.2 percent.
Government consumption rose 3.9 percent in the first nine months compared to the same period a year earlier.
Gross capital formation rose 13.0 percent in the first nine months over a similar period a year earlier, the Ministry said.
Total exports rose 14.9 percent in real terms from January to September, it said.
